notes: Core architecture is GO. A real Windows VS Code Claude Code 2.1.243 session received a PackRat-owned queued request through the documented Stop-hook continuation path and continued in the same conversation. PackRat stores only a short local preview of the latest real user prompt to make sessions human-identifiable without transcript scraping. The product does not claim external control of Claude Code's private native queued-message UI. Hook integration uses a per-install authenticated localhost endpoint, fail-safe session targeting, a six-continuation safety cap, a 9,000-character queue prompt ceiling, locked dependencies, and direct discovery of native Windows Claude Code plus the CLI bundled with VS Code and common VS Code forks.
